taskDefinition.name: Azure Email Send
taskDefinition.author: support@kineticdata.com
taskDefinition.description: Sends an email through the Microsoft Graph API sendMail endpoint.

parameter.label: Error Handling
parameter.tooltip: Determine what to return if an error is encountered.

parameter.label: From (Override)
parameter.tooltip: Sender mailbox to use instead of the handler's configured from_address. Leave blank to use the configured address.

parameter.label: To
parameter.tooltip: Comma or semicolon separated list of addresses. Display names are supported: Jane Doe <jane@example.com>. At least one recipient is required across To, CC, and BCC.

parameter.label: CC
parameter.tooltip: Comma or semicolon separated list of addresses.

parameter.label: BCC
parameter.tooltip: Comma or semicolon separated list of addresses.

parameter.label: HTML Body
parameter.tooltip: HTML content of the email. If both HTML Body and Text Body are provided, only the HTML Body is sent.

parameter.label: Text Body
parameter.tooltip: Plain text content of the email. Only sent when HTML Body is blank.
